Alx & I had never farmed a chicken but we are learning the ropes. We discovered the best time to check the nests is at night, when you can pick up the sleeping momma & she won’t move a muscle. 

We currently have 3 brooding hens, who have each laid over 20 eggs!!! We are wanting to grow the flock and are trying to figure out which ones to keep & which to cook.

Look at the pics- can you tell which eggs have babies inside them? 🇨🇷🐣🤔 #joefelz #chickenfarming #homesteading #selfreliance #eggs

caption.text:
We went back to explore the witch mountain of Escazú, leaving at 3:30 am to catch the sunrise over Pico Blanco. It was an intense experience where 4 friends sat silently for a half hour to watch the miracle of the sun making its return on the horizon. 

More to follow on what we found in the mountain, which didn’t have directions to get where we were wanting to go. Fun times in strange places 🇨🇷☀️⛰️ #joefelz #sunrise #friendship #introspection #explorer

caption.text:
What’s the pace of life like in Costa Rica? Well, so slow that even hummingbirds sit still.

Every morning “Hammy,” my hummingbird friend, perches on a branch & chirps good morning to me. Never had a birdfriend before. 

We also have a nesting pair of toucans in the backyard. Toucan “Sam,” & his wife who have made a nest in a balsa tree hollow. Sam is very unique because he has a green beak unlike all of the other ones I have seen.

It’s pretty cool watching toucans in real life after only seeing them on cereal boxes growing up. I think this what they mean by Pura Vida 🦜🇨🇷🐧 #joefelz #puravida #birdwatching #wildlife #naturelover

caption.text:
On Easter Sunday I, much like Jesus, said “it is finished” 🧎‍♂️

12 months of planning, 4 month navigating Costa Rican import, one week building a tower & 6 days installing equipment, the Felz Finca is finally off grid. 

I have dreamt about an offer at Homestead since I was a child and today it became my reality. So as my finca runs of Sonpower this Easter, I implore you to remember that “faith without works is dead” = quit dreaming and go build the life you’ve always wanted 🇨🇷☀️✝️ #joefelz #offgrid #solar #faith #dreamscometrue
